purpose: Transparent foreground layer for opt-in doorway hero prototype. Live HTML is behind the transparent opening.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Reference image: retain its sculptural architectural language and photoreal material quality, but create a new production foreground asset.
Asset: one freestanding architectural arch frame ONLY, on a genuinely transparent background, with a genuinely transparent opening. No door leaf. No wall or backdrop behind the opening. No scene behind the arch. No floor plane. Alpha transparency must show both outside AND through the interior.
Form: refined THIN warm ivory honed limestone outer rim and restrained dark forest-green metal inner reveal. Same family as the reference, but the opening is broader and the solid rim is approximately one fifth as thick as the reference. A very small copper hinge detail on the right inner reveal, without a door attached.
View: nearly frontal, very mild three-quarter perspective, naturally matched studio light from upper left. The arch must read as a convincing tactile object with physical thickness, fine limestone and green anodized metal, not a flat vector icon. No visual effects, no bloom.
Composition: square canvas. Outer arch extends approximately from x=13% to x=87%, y=3% to y=97%. Interior opening extends approximately from x=23% to x=77%, y=13% to y=97%, with round arched top. The bottom of the arch is OPEN with two vertical legs; no stone threshold spans the bottom. Leave an entirely transparent void between the legs. No shadow painted over the transparent void. Show complete top and both feet.
It will be layered IN FRONT of a real HTML website to frame a visible digital experience. Therefore interior transparency is critical; do not fill the opening with ivory, green, white, checkerboard, scenery, an image, a door or any other pixels.
No typography, no logos, no watermark.
